results.pair_summary: Doc A defines the normative R2.0-C Observability Constitution (types, operations, invariants), while Doc B implements the corresponding verification suite (tests d1-d7) validating those specific constraints. They share identical semantic requirements but serve distinct roles as definition versus enforcement.
results.integration_rationale: Doc A acts as the architectural contract for Delta3 Kernel observability, while Doc B serves as the executable test harness. Merging them would conflate high-level invariants with low-level test utilities (fixtures/assertions). They should remain separate to maintain separation of concerns; however, Doc B should ideally import types from Doc A via module references to prevent specification drift.
